title: Adaptation of the STAIR-NT for First Responders
official: Adaptation of the STAIR-NT Intervention to Respond to Psychological Health Conditions for First Responders With a History of Traumatic Brain Injury
summary: This study is a randomized controlled pilot examining the implementation of an adapted intervention, Skills Training in Affective and Interpersonal Regulation-Narrative Therapy (STAIR-NT), among a first responder population with a history of TBI and PTSD.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* be a first responder within the state of Minnesota
* have a history of a TBI
* screen for PTSD.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet inclusion criteria.
